title: Set larger dummy covalent radii for large elements
body:
Closes #1635

I think the request in the above issue to use a more reasonable dummy covalent radii for elements with Z > 96 is reasonable, which is done in the present MR.
To distinguish it from a "real" dummy element X, a new constant `_R_DUMMY` is also introduced.

I think the only potential danger is that some users might misunderstood the given dummy value as the real one reported in some literature.
I would however argue that the same issue exists even now, even it gives apparently small dummy value.
